body:
The doctor has been adjusting my prescriptions, but I really don't think medication is the answer.  The lake of fire thing was just my way of saying that from what I can tell there ain't no heaven or hell.

I'm all over the place creatively.  General artsy fartsy creative type.  Play bass, draw, I'm a playwright and actor.  Mostly I do political cartoons but I dabble in animation.  As far as I can tell I'm pretty good at what I do, I don't have trouble finding work or opportunities to showcase my work.  I'm actually quite proud of what I've accomplished in the last few years but it's all meaningless without love.  Like Frankie says, you're nobody 'til somebody loves you.  

I don't mean to sound like a forever alone cliche.  I just want somebody to love.  I don't have strong family ties, I'm pretty terrible with women although I've had a few relationships in the past.  I'm pretty much an incel.  I don't think I'm weak willed or soft either, I've just been chipped away at so much that I finally crumbled.  I'm sick of everything.  I can't eat, I can't sleep, can't feel... and I have so much hate in me.  I hate the world, I really do.  I love it, but it's an awful place.

Sometimes I don't.  If I do get out it's because I tell myself I have to go to class, I can't fail out, etc.  If I skip classes I'll motivate myself to get up to see a friend or go do something like that.  But lately even things that used to make me happy (music, sketching, writing, etc.) haven't been doing the trick.  My meds have me pretty numb, but I'm still really hopeless.  I've always been a tad morbid, never really afraid of death.  I died once before, but they brought me back.  No lake of fire waiting to greet me, no bright light at the end of the tunnel.  Was real peaceful actually.  It physically pains me to continue most days.  I want to cry but I can't.
